gap_07_meaning: A 3D explicit-wire frictional-contact FE system can combine established transformation-aware NiTi updates with membrane traction and actual packing without a presently identified missing field equation. This is a formulation-level verdict only; numerical implementation and locked forward adequacy remain open.

primary_precedents.contribution: Explicit-wire 3D solid FE, Souza transformation-aware UMAT, interwire friction under tension
primary_precedents.boundary: helical tensile examples only; no pressurized membrane or bending test

primary_precedents.contribution: 3D geometrically nonlinear bending, sheaths, radial outer pressure, normal penalty and Coulomb component contact
primary_precedents.boundary: elastic cable constituents, component-scale FE rather than resolved MP1 wires
published contact smooth/frictionless and load tensile

primary_precedents.contribution: Short-rope beam stick/slip stiffness bounds as reduced consistency comparator

mechanical_domain.specimen: actual straight or manufactured MP1 wire packing, wire count and dimensions, not copied helical lay
loads: prescribed pressure history p(t) on fluid-wetted membrane surface
outputs: tangent and secant bending stiffness under stated definitions

field_and_interface_specification.name: wire_balance
field_and_interface_specification.equation: div(sigma_i)+b_i=0 in each wire i, with finite-deformation form and consistent work conjugacy selected at implementation
field_and_interface_specification.status: INFERENCE: standard FE balance; implementation choice must be verified

field_and_interface_specification.name: NiTi_constitutive
field_and_interface_specification.equation: sigma_i=F(epsilon_i,z_i,T_i;theta_NiTi), z_i advanced by an established transformation evolution/update with unloading and cycle history
field_and_interface_specification.status: VERIFIED FULL TEXT precedent: Vahidi 2021/2022 Souza Eqs. (1)-(8); exact MP1 parameter set absent

field_and_interface_specification.name: normal_contact
field_and_interface_specification.equation: g_n>=0, lambda_n>=0, g_n*lambda_n=0, or convergence-equivalent regularized enforcement
field_and_interface_specification.status: INFERENCE: standard contact form; Tjahjanto reports nonlinear normal penalty

field_and_interface_specification.name: tangential_contact
field_and_interface_specification.equation: |t_t|<=mu*lambda_n in stick; sliding traction opposes tangential relative velocity at the bound
field_and_interface_specification.status: INFERENCE: Coulomb form; Tjahjanto states Coulomb tangential law and Vahidi uses frictional interwire contact

field_and_interface_specification.name: fluid_boundary
field_and_interface_specification.equation: sigma_mem*n=-p(t)*n on the actual fluid-wetted membrane surface, subject to chosen traction sign convention
field_and_interface_specification.status: INFERENCE: traction boundary; Tjahjanto applies radial pressure to outer sheath

field_and_interface_specification.name: transmission
field_and_interface_specification.equation: lambda_n(x,t)=G[p(t), membrane deformation, packing, prestrain, curvature, contact history;theta_phys] as an FE prediction or independently calibrated bounded map
field_and_interface_specification.status: INFERENCE: p is not equal to lambda_n or a single interwire normal force

constitutive_branch.baseline: An established 3D transformation-aware NiTi law with internal transformation strain and temperature dependence, provisionally Souza per Vahidi; compare accepted alternatives only before model lock using calibration/verification, never held-out bending.
constitutive_branch.history: Transformation loading/unloading state and contact stick/slip memory retained.
constitutive_branch.thermal_rule: Isothermal approximation only after S02 thermal/rate pilots bound temperature effects relative to the discrimination margin; otherwise coupled heat balance and transformation latent heat are required before S05 lock.
constitutive_branch.tension_compression: Vahidi assumes symmetry; MP1 bending may require an independently characterized established asymmetric NiTi option if single-wire tests show material asymmetry.

physical_parameters: NiTi moduli, transformation thresholds/hardening and temperature coefficients
wire surface friction coefficient(s) and independently justified rate/state dependence if needed
wire radii, length, initial curvature and surface condition
numerical_parameters: normal/tangential penalty stiffness or Lagrange-multiplier tolerances
stabilization/damping used solely for solver convergence
parameter_rule: Numerical parameters must pass convergence and work/energy checks and may not be freely tuned to fit bending data. Physical parameters must be independently calibrated or bounded from non-validation tests.
adaptations: Replace helix with actual MP1 packing; no assumed helical topology
model membrane and correct wetted traction boundary
include NiTi transformation and friction simultaneously
represent measured prestrain, axial load, clamps, finite bending and section ovalization
verify local output extraction and thermal branch
not_yet_shown: actual coexistence of slip and transformation in a durable sealed specimen
identifiability or measurability of local state
need for any new constitutive-contact coupling term
